in_marathi.name: Ancharika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ancharika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ancharika is a Sanskrit female name derived from the goddess Ancharani, the deity of wisdom and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Ancharani is believed to bestow intelligence and knowledge upon her devotees. The name Ancharika is a tribute to this goddess and symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and intelligence.
